preamble.description: Noctis Zone — own trading venue for graduated launches (Aiken). Pool datum, royalty withdraw path and helper libs vendored from Splash splash-core validators_v3 (CC0-1.0 / Apache-2.0), see NOTICE.

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
cardano/address/StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

noctisswap/orders/DepositConfig.title: DepositConfig
noctisswap/orders/DepositConfig.description:
A request to add liquidity: both assets in, LQ out to the placer.
 `collateral_ada` is ADA the placer set aside so the reward output can
 exist; it must come back to them.

noctisswap/orders/OrderAction.title: OrderAction
noctisswap/orders/OrderAction.description: Apply is what an executor does; Refund is what the placer does.

noctisswap/orders/RedeemConfig.title: RedeemConfig
noctisswap/orders/RedeemConfig.description: A request to remove liquidity: LQ in, both assets out to the placer.

noctisswap/orders/SwapAction.title: SwapAction
noctisswap/orders/SwapAction.description:
Fill names the pool, the order and the order's successor: the placer's
 reward output when the order completes, or the continuing order when it
 fills in part.

noctisswap/orders/SwapConfig.title: SwapConfig
noctisswap/orders/SwapConfig.description:
A swap request against one pool. The placer trades `tradable_input` of
 `input` for `output` at no worse than `base_price` (output per input),
 pays the executor `ex_fee` lovelace for the whole order, pro rata on a
 partial fill, and accepts no partial fill smaller than
 `min_marginal_output`. An empty `permitted_executors` means anyone may fill.
